description_html:
This replacement Wacom One X-Shape Cable was created specifically for the Wacom One creative pen display. Connects via HDMI and USB-A to Mac or PC. (Requires 3rd party adaptor to connect to Android*) *

List of Compatible Android Devices and their compatible adaptor

  • Huawei Mate 20 Pro - ARKTEK, atk-ctominidp-2-au
  • Huawei Mate 30 Pro - Baseus CAHUB-AT01
  • Huawei P20 Pro - Huawei MateDock
  • Huawei P30 - Huawei MateDock2
  • Samsung Galaxy Note 10 - iTeknic IK-UC002
  • Samsung Galaxy Note 10+ - Samsung DeXPad/ EE-M5100
  • Samsung Galaxy Note 8 - Samsung DeXStation/ EE-MG950
  • Samsung Galaxy Note 9 - Sanwa supply AD-ALCMHD01
  • Samsung Galaxy S10+ - Ugren 70411
  • Samsung Galaxy S8
